issue.description:
Found 2026-08-20 while installing plan-review 2.0. The in-progress lib extraction (uncommitted WIP in plan-author/plan-review/readme-review/spec-review scripts, untracked lib/common.sh) has each script do: source "$(dirname "$0")/../../lib/common.sh". Correct inside the repo, but once a skill is installed to ~/.claude/skills/<skill>/ that path resolves to ~/.claude/lib/common.sh. install.sh copies only the skill directory, so every refactored script fails at its source line with 'No such file or directory' (verified: installed plan-review/scripts/scan-headers.sh exits 1). Recommended: (c). Acceptance: plan-review's SELF-TEST fixture and scan-headers.sh run green from the INSTALLED path, and scripts/check-installed.sh reports no drift.

Until fixed, the installed plan-review carries the HEAD (self-contained) scan-headers.sh and score-plan.sh, so check-installed.sh reports drift on those two files by design.
